distanceRendering.recommendation: Skip spawning in chunks not rendered; clamp spawn radius to min(presetRadius, renderDistance*16*0.5).

mobDensityReduction.basis: count of hostile/Mob entities within 16 blocks of the player
mobDensityReduction.smoothing: lerp 20% per second to avoid popping

combatVisibility.rule: Environmental effects must never obstruct visibility during combat. No effect may cover the crosshair area of an enemy; never place particles between camera and target within 6 blocks.

performance.implementationSketch: No Java provided. A developer applies: finalRate = baseRate * presetMul * dayNightMul * weatherMul * mobMul * combatMul; stop spawning when aliveCount >= preset.maxParticlesAlive.
